UC's current live undergraduate business catalogue (MGB1xx series) has majors in HRM (MGB103), International Business (MGB104), Management (MGB105), Marketing (MGB106), Sport Management (MGB108) and general Business (MGB109), but no standalone Accounting bachelor's degree or Accounting major bachelor code currently live; accounting study now lives inside the Bachelor of Business as the Specialist Major in Accounting (SM0016, https://www.canberra.edu.au/major/SM0016/1), and separately as the standalone Master of Professional Accounting (297JA, live for 2026/2027). Do not reuse SM0016 major content as if it were this distinct discontinued degree.

name: Graduate Certificate in Accounting
reason: Real UC course code MGC001 found and verified live. Page explicitly states 'This course is not open for new admissions.' Two versions exist (v1 -> 2021, v2 -> 2024); no version redirects to 2026/2027/2028 and MGC001 is absent from the current course sitemap. 'About this course' prose (real, sourced) describes it as being for students with an overseas accounting qualification needing 4 units (12cp), explicitly not meeting professional-body accreditation as a standalone award, with a described pathway 'to progress to UC's G[raduate Diploma in Accounting]' (text was cut off in extraction but the pattern matches the Grad Dip page's parallel pathway sentence to the Master's).
